name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-assisted presentations that actually look like a human made them.
problem: Most AI presentation tools produce generic, templated slides that undermine credibility and brand identity. Chronicle 2.0 addresses the tension between AI-generated speed and design quality, giving teams polished decks without the tell-tale AI aesthetic. It helps professionals move fast without sacrificing the visual sophistication that matters in high-stakes business contexts.
useCases: Creating investor pitch decks with a refined, non-generic look
Building client-facing proposals and sales presentations quickly
Producing internal strategy or roadmap decks with consistent brand quality
Rapidly iterating on conference or keynote slide narratives
